eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Owyhee, ID; at 5:50 PM on JUL 25, 2026 Effective until 7:50 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Owyhee county has issued a civil emergency alert for the Jordan Valley Area in Idaho. Big Grass Fire is uncontained and moving rapidly. Jordan Valley in Malheur County Oregon is under Level 1 evacuation. Be prepared to evacuate. Contact Owyhee County at 2 0 8 4 9 5 1 2 0 5 for additional information. This message was sent by the Idaho State Communications Center and is now concluded.
